Buyer Added Bid Specific Scope Of Work(SOW) Text Clause(s) Scope of Work for contractors: Job includes the following: S.No Description 1.0 Fitment, removal and replacement of engines, transmissions, gearboxes , differentials and other major sub-assemblies of dumpers, dozers, grade 1.0 rs, loaders, tyre handler, crane, including shifting and cleaning of disma ntled assemblies/components before fitment. 2.0 Checking, tightening, torquing and untorquing of bolts such as track rolle r bolts, track chain bolts, cabin mounting bolts, tire bolts, foundation bolt s and other critical bolts of dumpers, dozers, graders, loader, tyre handle r and crane. 3.0 Routine, preventive and scheduled maintenance of dumpers, dozers, gra ders, loaders and other tyre mounted machines, including checking of oil levels, air pressure, batteries, auto-electrical systems and other machine parameters. 4.0 Lubrication and charging of front and rear suspension systems of dumpe rs, including charging of suspension cylinders as required.

5.0 Maintenance, removal and replacement of auto-electrical components s uch as self-starters, alternators, fans, lights, batteries and associated ele ctrical systems of HEMMs. 6.0 Removal and replacement of radiators, coolers, hoses, air cleaner elem ents and other associated components of dumpers, dozers, graders and water sprinklers as per requirement/scheduled maintenance. 7.0 Removal, shifting and replacement of cutting edges, end bits and other wear components of dozers and motor graders, including removal of wor n-out components and torquing of new components. 8.0 Maintenance and handling of hydraulic cylinders, including shifting, clea ning, removal and replacement of lift, tilt, tensioning, front suspension a nd rear suspension cylinders of HEMMs. 9.0 Repairing, dismantling, fitting and maintenance of OTR tyres, including r emoval/replacement of tyres and related tyre maintenance activities. 10.0 Shifting and handling of HEMM components, materials and consumables, including engines, transmissions, undercarriages, gearboxes, differential s, batteries, lubricants, oxygen/D.A. cylinders and other materials betwe en Stores, Auto Shop, Machine Shop and job sites. 11.0 Cleaning and housekeeping of HEMM maintenance areas, machines and components, including cleaning of diesel tanks, radiators, coolers and di smantled assemblies, and disposal/shifting of generated scrap to Stores, in compliance with ISO 14001 and ISO 9001 requirements. 12.0 Carrying out lubrication activities in dumpers, dozers and other HEMMs. 13.0 Replacement and repair of water pump installed in Karo, Ghagirathi and Dalmia pump house.
